name: za.co.getlawed/sa-law
title: GetLawED — Verified South African Law
description: South African legal research: official judgments, Acts, by-laws; quote sections, check citations

tools.name: legal_library_search
tools.description: Search GetLawED's library of official South African legal texts (Constitutional Court, SCA, High Court, Labour, Land, Tax and tribunal judgments; Acts; regulations, rules and codes issued under them; municipal by-laws and land use schemes; Bills; Government Gazettes). Returns matching documents with the best-matching section reference where the text is split into sections, a short passage and the official source link. Absence from the library does not mean an authority does not exist. South African law only unless country is given (e.g. "GB" for United Kingdom Acts).

query.description: What to look for, in plain language (e.g. "business rescue post-commencement tax debt")

doc_type.description: Limit to one kind of document: regulation = regulations, rules and codes; bylaw = municipal by-laws and land use schemes (default: judgment, act and regulation)

country.description: Jurisdiction to search. Default "ZA" = South African law only. "GB" = United Kingdom Acts of Parliament (legislation.gov.uk, revised text; Open Government Licence v3.0 — show the attribution returned with each result). "all" = every jurisdiction held. Each result carries its country and jurisdiction: only results with country "ZA" are South African law — never present a result from another country as South African law.

tools.name: legal_get_section
tools.description: Full text of one document section from the GetLawED library — use it to read and quote the exact provision found by legal_library_search (give the doc_id and the section reference it returned). For judgments, returns the judgment text (or the part matching "section", e.g. a paragraph number or phrase), capped at 12 000 characters.

section.description: Section reference as returned (e.g. "Section 34: Structures") or a section number like "34"; optional for judgments

tools.name: legal_verify_citations
tools.description: Check the South African case citations and Acts in a piece of text against GetLawED's library of official copies and verified records. Each item comes back as found, found_by_citation (a bare citation with no party names that resolves to a judgment we hold — parties were not compared, so confirm the name in the returned title), mismatch (the citation belongs to a different case), name_only, not_found, repealed or unchecked. "not_found"/"unchecked" means "check the law reports", not "fake".

tools.name: bylaws_find_municipality
tools.description: Turn a South African town, suburb or municipality name (e.g. "Hermanus", "Centurion", "Mossel Bay") into its municipality, province and district, and list which municipal by-laws GetLawED holds for it by topic, whether its land use / zoning scheme and planning by-law are held, and the council's own by-law page. Start here for any question about local rules (building, boundary walls, second dwellings, home businesses, signage, keeping animals, water, refuse, trading). Does not hold the zoning of individual erven.

place.description: Town, suburb or municipality name, or a municipal code such as "WC043" or "CPT". Not a street address or erf number.

tools.name: bylaws_for_place
tools.description: The municipal by-laws and land use schemes GetLawED holds for a South African place, optionally for one topic — each with its status (in force / amended / repealed), promulgation date, gazette reference, official source link and doc_id for legal_get_section. Repealed by-laws are left out unless asked for.

place.description: Town, suburb or municipality name, or a municipal code (e.g. "WC043")

topic.description: Only one topic: planning (land use, zoning, rezoning), building (building, signage, fencing), finance (rates, tariffs, credit control), utilities (water, sanitation, electricity), waste, roads_traffic, public_spaces (amenities, nuisances, noise), business (trading, liquor, guest houses), health_environment, animals, safety (fire, events, land invasion), governance, other

tools.name: zoning_scheme_for_place
tools.description: The land use / zoning scheme (zoning scheme regulations) and the municipal planning by-law that apply in a South African place, with dates, gazette references, official links and doc_ids. These set what each zone allows (coverage, height, building lines, parking, consent uses) and how to apply for rezoning or departures. It does NOT say how a particular erf is zoned — that is on the municipality's zoning map or zoning certificate.

place.description: Town, suburb or municipality name, or a municipal code (e.g. "WC043")

tools.name: bylaw_rules_for
tools.description: Find the sections of a South African municipality's by-laws and zoning scheme on one subject — e.g. "boundary wall height", "second dwelling", "home business", "keeping chickens", "building line", "signage", "noise" — and quote their wording with the by-law title, section number, status and official link. Read a whole section with legal_get_section (doc_id + section). Repealed by-laws are left out.

place.description: Town, suburb or municipality name, or a municipal code (e.g. "WC043")

subject.description: The subject in a few plain words (e.g. "boundary wall height")

topic.description: Optional: search only by-laws of this topic

tools.name: find_law_firms
tools.description: Find South African law firms (on GetLawED) that accept consultation bookings from AI assistants. Filter by practice area and/or city/province. Returns each firm's id to use with the other tools.

practice_area.description: Area of law the person needs help with

city.description: City or town, e.g. "Cape Town", "Gqeberha" (old names such as Port Elizabeth also work)

tools.name: get_firm
tools.description: Details of one firm: about, location, practice areas, languages, and the consultations it offers (with duration, price and any deposit).

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Free consultation times at a firm on one date (South African time). Use a start time from here in request_consultation.

tools.name: request_consultation
tools.description: Request a consultation at a firm for the person you are helping. This is a REQUEST: the firm first checks for conflicts of interest and then confirms or declines by email. Only use details the person gave you, and only with their consent. Do not include confidential or privileged details — a one-line reason is enough.

start.description: A start time returned by check_availability (ISO 8601)

reason.description: One or two sentences on what the consultation is about (no confidential details)

other_parties.description: Names of any other people or companies involved — lets the firm check for conflicts of interest

consent.description: true only if the person agreed that their details may be shared with this firm to arrange the consultation

assistant_name.description: Name of the AI assistant making the request (optional)
